request.instructions: keep it stable at high speed, easy and good turning at high and low speed, high mass to allow for better handling, fast acceleration

changes.reason: Increase vehicle mass for better planted, stable high-speed behavior.
Support easy turning at both low and high speed.
Improve yaw and roll stability for high-speed driving.
Reduce body roll and improve cornering stability.
Keep the car balanced through turns.
Slightly favor rear stability while preserving agile turning.

security.summary: The pack contains only vehicle assets and metadata, plus a benign legacy __resource.lua with data-only declarations. No executable scripts, webhooks, downloads, process execution, or obfuscated payloads were found.

findings.reason: Legacy manifest is data-only and does not contain executable logic; stale optional reference to vehiclelayouts.meta is harmless because the importer rebuilds the manifest from existing files.

repairs.issue: References an optional metadata file not present in the inventory (vehiclelayouts.meta).
repairs.action: Omit the missing path when generating the fresh manifest.
